verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML and compliance risk platform, and duplicate-identity detection is a plausible risk capability for a buyer to ask about, so the axis applies. However, the evidence covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, risk scoring, case management, monitoring and transaction monitoring. Nothing shows face or document biometric matching, or automatic flagging of the same face or document resurfacing under different names.
